subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in the processing of your recent purchase due to unforeseen circumstances. Rest assured, our team is working diligently to resolve this issue and expedite the delivery of your order. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your patience. Should you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services.
